annotatedSteps.description: State the Basic Proportionality Theorem ratio
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect statement of BPT; the ratio should be AD/DB = AE/EC (or AD/AB = AE/AC)
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: In △ABC, DE ∥ BC, so by BPT, AD/DB = AE/EC

annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect final answer resulting from wrong formula

teacherNote: Marked against: Stating the Basic Proportionality Theorem ratio: AD/DB = AE/EC (1); Substituting the given values into the correct ratio (2/3 = 4/EC) (1); Solving for EC to obtain EC = 6 cm (1). Remember that the Basic Proportionality Theorem equates corresponding segments: AD/DB = AE/EC. Do not mix part-to-whole (AD/AB) with part-to-part (AE/EC). Using the correct ratio gives EC = 6 cm.
